ns2:section.sectionText: Meets in room GSLIS 242. Hybrid course - meets with LIS 590TX. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://online.illinois.edu. This course introduces students to the knowledge discovery process and methods used to mine patterns from a collection of text. We will critically review text mining methods developed in the knowledge discovery and databases, information science, and computational linguistics communities. Students will develop proficiency with modeling text through individual projects.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Library & Information Science department.
